items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Heumann had left him to go with Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: Clarence Todd, he did. That's the same song. We can talk to Camilla sometime. Yeah, he was, not so very long ago he was there, you know. Camilla lives uptown. And I also, for Alvin, I got Lois Domain, you know, Lois, I knew you know what it was. I got Lois Domain, what he said then, you know. Well after he sat in the band and taught me, because he used to coach me and tell me a lot of things, he can mention, valuable ideas about the trumpet, little tricks about the trumpet, you know. So after he sat in the band,…

He kind of hoity so, but he broke his own. And well the people know the Budweiser back and at least they want to sue the Budweiser people. So they backed out. See they had to go back to the front and they pulled out the interciser out of there. And after they played there about a few years, I can show you some words that a fella, we call him Mestedi. I don't know if you know him, he loved dances. A fella, he even reminded me of Mestedi. He used to come and that man would stand inside the band stand and he'd clap…
The guy used to be with Jimmy Gunn.
